title: Thursday Quick Tip
subtitle: An all-games practice
hook: What if your next practice was just games?
statement: Sometimes the best practice is the one kids play most.
q1: Do you plan an all-games practice now and then —
q2: or keep a regular plan every time?
q3: What do kids learn when they just play?
t1: There is no perfect answer here. But energy comes back
t2: when practice feels like play again.
cta: Coaches — do you ever just play games?
ctaLines: Once a month. Before a break. Never.
All games or the usual plan?
ctaPrompt: Share your practice habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
What if your next practice was just games?
The season has been long. Drills feel like work.
Sometimes the best practice is the one kids play most.
An all-games practice or the usual plan. There is no single right way.
Do you ever just play games? Share your habit in the comments.
